subject: Activity plan & contract stitch for Novasys pilot — sequencing checklist
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novasys.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot timeline & initial MAP request (Novasys)

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership wants to lock a pilot start window for July 1 so we can collect usage data ahead of a potential enterprise rollout. Procurement and legal asked me to gather: the Mutual Action Plan (high level milestones), any DPA redline guidance you typically accept, and a realistic close timeline that sequences MSA/DPA/order form sign-off.

Constraints:
- We have a downstream regulatory review the week of 7/8 — pilot access needs to be in place before that.
- Our internal legal (cc'd below when available) will want to run an initial redline.
- Budget approval is in motion but they want a purchase order by 6/24 if possible.

Can you share a sequencing checklist and a short MAP we can use in our internal kickoff? Prefer a single file we can attach to our procurement packet.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Platform Ops, Novasys Therapeutics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novasys.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline & initial MAP request (Novasys)

Daniel —

Appreciate the context and timeline. Attached is a first-pass MAP that lays out the minimal sequencing to get pilot access by July 1 while keeping legal review concurrent. High-level notes:

- Week of 5/15: Redwood provides MAP + DPA reference redline and SOC2 evidence bundle (we'll surface the SOC2 report and relevant audit logs).
- 5/22–5/29: Novasys legal reviews MSA/DPA redlines in parallel; procurement finalizes PO terms (target PO by 6/24).
- 6/01–6/10: Finalize order form and scoped SOW; technical onramp scheduling for pilot provisioning.
- 6/17: Target MSA signature (we've found that signature first with an order form executed quickly after reduces procurement back-and-forth).
- 6/20–6/30: Provisioning, short run validation, pilot kickoff 7/01.

I've looped Vanessa (contracts lead) and Karthik (legal ops/solutions) to own the redline coordination and to flag anything that would push the dates out. Attached: novasys_map_v1.xlsx (simple milestone table) and a checklist for evidence requests.

Quick asks for you: who specifically from Novasys Legal will drive the DPA redline? Also, is the PO path single approver or multi-stage? That determines whether we should recommend a phased provisioning holdback.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
Attachment: novasys_map_v1.xlsx (MAP milestone table, 2 sheets)
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@novasys.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novasys.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline & initial MAP request (Novasys)

Thanks Grace — I'm Novasys' legal lead on this. A few items from our side after a quick skim of the MAP:

- We will provide a consolidated redline and comments on the DPA; attached is our initial scope document and preferred edits (see Novasys_DPA_redline_v0.3.docx).
- SOC2 evidence: we need a copy of the latest SOC2 Type II, an inventory of subprocessors, and a short note on data retention/location for pilot data.
- Liability cap and data residency are likely the sticking points; please flag any standard carveouts Redwood typically offers for pilot-only engagements.

We aim to return a consolidated DPA redline by 5/22; procurement will push to close PO approvals by 6/24 but legal timeline may push an MSA signature into the week of 6/17–6/21 depending on comments.

Kind regards,
Priya Menon
Senior Counsel, Novasys Therapeutics
Attachment: Novasys_DPA_redline_v0.3.docx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novasys.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@novasys.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing — proposed checklist and owners

Daniel/Priya —

Putting a concrete sequencing checklist on the table so procurement and legal have clear owners and gating criteria. I've included target dates to align with your June PO ask. If Novasys legal returns DPA comments on 5/22 we can keep the following flow intact: 

1) Redwood provides SOC2 + subprocessor list + DPA reference redline — owner: Redwood (Grace) — deliver by 5/15 (done).
2) Novasys Legal provides consolidated DPA redline — owner: Novasys (Priya) — target 5/22.
3) Redwood Contracts (Vanessa) triages redline and surfaces high-risk clauses (liability, residency, access controls) — target 5/24.
4) Parallel: Procurement finalizes PO terms (Daniel) — target 6/24.
5) Final negotiation window for MSA: 6/01–6/17. If MSA can be signed by 6/17 we will fast-track order form and provisioning.
6) If MSA signature slips past 6/21, we recommend a staging plan: limited pilot with test credentials while redlines finalize; full production access after signature.

Related links: MAP draft and a short SOW template here — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovasys-MAP (Grace has edit access).

Comment on liabilities: for pilot engagements we can typically accept a reduced liability cap tied to pilot fees; we'll surface standard language in the triage doc on 5/24.

If that sequence looks good I can prepare a one-page execution checklist for procurement to attach to the PO packet.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novasys.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@novasys.com>
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/DPA/Order Form sequencing — proposed checklist and owners

Thanks all — quick confirmation and two contingency items:

- We're aligned on the flow Vanessa outlined. Grace, please add the SOC2 artifact and the standard subprocessor list to the MAP folder (I will pull them for triage).
- Contingency A (if legal pushes past 6/21): Redwood will provide a limited pilot access agreement (one-page) that allows access for up to 30 days with restricted data retention settings; this is signed by an engineering lead and procurement and removes the need for a full MSA signature for initial access.
- Contingency B (if procurement PO is delayed): we can accept a short-term invoice and net-30 term to enable provisioning, but that requires a payment assurance note from Novasys finance.

Next steps: Grace to upload artifacts by EOD Monday (5/21). Vanessa and I will prep the triage memo for 5/24. Daniel/Priya, if you can confirm the PO approver routing (single approver vs multi-stage) we will incorporate the appropriate gating notes into the execution checklist.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Legal Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
